verdict.rationale: A runtime probe of npm shows the core phaser package is MIT-licensed, a permissive license that carries no royalties or per-install fees. The pricing page also states that paid editor licences come with "Full commercial rights" and that games you create "are not linked to the licence," so revenue stays with the studio. Missing for 10: a first-party docs or license page explicitly stating no royalties or revenue share, and independent community corroboration about shipping commercial games royalty-free.
